newsitem.title: USA: Bob Evans ends talks to sell salad company.
newsitem.headline: Bob Evans ends talks to sell salad company.

text.p: Bob Evans Farms Inc said on Tuesday it terminated talks over the prospective sale of assets of Mrs. Giles Country Kitchens to Horizon Partners Ltd.
On September 24, Bob Evans said it signed a letter of intent for Horizon to purchase the unit, which makes fresh deli salads and distributes them in the eastern United States.

The company was not immediately available to comment on why the deal fell through. The tentative plan had been subject to certain factors including the completion of due diligence and negotiation of a definitive purchase agreement.
Horizon provides equity capital to private companies to finance their growth and to support management buyout deals.
